themes.corpus_position: Minoxidil is highly toxic to pets, both cats and dogs. So, if your pets sleep on your head or near your head or on your pillow or they might lick your head or your pillow, these just might be risks that you're not willing to take. Regardless of whether you apply it in the morning or night, you want to make sure it's completely dry and to wash your hands after to protect your pets. Or an alternative is that you talk to your doctor about oral minoxidil instead.

news.headline: FDA approves first treatment for 'skin writing' hives (symptomatic dermographism)
news.summary: Announced Oct 7: Novartis's oral pill Rhapsido (remibrutinib), already approved for chronic spontaneous hives, is now the first FDA-approved treatment for adults whose symptomatic dermographism — hives and itch raised by everyday friction, scratching or rubbing, the condition often called 'skin writing' — isn't controlled by antihistamines. In the phase 3 RemIND trial 29.3% were completely hive-free at week 12 vs 14.0% on placebo, with responses as early as week 2. It is a visual, easy-to-demonstrate condition and a gap for you: 0 transcripts mention dermatographia, and your hives explainer is a 13-minute YouTube video from Feb 2023 (5K views). The trend feed is from Oct 7, so whether tracked creators have picked it up isn't visible.
news.her_angle: 'Can you write on your skin? There's now a pill approved for that' — what dermatographia is, in 30 seconds (needs her take)
